rv.q: Watching DEAR EVAN HANSEN live is an experience that stays with you long after the final curtain call—an emotional journey that is as thought-provoking as it is beautiful.
Michael Fabisch is giving a performance that's not likely to be bettered on any West Coast stage anytime soon.
This cleansing musical works so well because it’s an original, not based on some cartoon, film adaptation, or a musician’s catalog of past hits.
It's a really moving, empowering show that will make you smile and laugh and cry.
Dear Evan Hansen is a poignant meditation on the difficulty of being truly seen and understood in a world that increasingly values online personas over authenticity.
The strength of the performances and the emotional core of Dear Evan Hansen remain undeniable.
The musical offers a sobering reminder of the emotional toll of living in a world that demands so much of our focus, and yet so little of our empathy.

cn.t: Critics praise this emotionally powerful musical for its moving storytelling and strong performances. The show's honest exploration of teen anxiety and isolation, paired with compelling music, creates a deeply affecting theatrical experience.
